Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> mirddes wrote:
> im doubtful it does, pays to be sure as always however.
>
I don't fully understand your question, and I can't see any cardtext related to the question.

> Name: Nickolai, The Survivor
> [Third:V]
> Cardtype: Vampire
> Clan: Tremere antitribu
> Group: 4
> Capacity: 6
> Discipline: aus dom pot pre tha vic
> Sabbat: Nickolai may gain 1 level of any Discipline another of your ready vampires has at superior as a +1 stealth action that costs 1 blood.
>
Nickolai can gain 1 level of any Discipline.... as an action. You don't need a Master: discipline card to represent that, if that is the question.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
Correct answer from Ankha.
He also doesn't get +1 generation when performing this action (just in case people were considering a turbo Nickolai... that won't work).
